note: PRODUCTION budgets (USD), r/boxoffice convention: the number used for break-even math, NOT a marketing-inclusive figure. Source order per film: the studio's own filing (UK Companies House / Disney disclosures) net of rebates where one exists; otherwise Box Office Mojo's production figure; otherwise the widely cited figure, lower bound of a range. Every entry here is budget_estimated:true. Applied last, after BOM and Wikipedia. The 2026-09-08 audit found six MCU films pinned to $200M pre-release guesses while filings showed $236M to $534M; those now carry the filed net figure. Superman was pinned at $225M which matches BOM verbatim, so the override was a no-op and Ledger flagged the discrepancy; removed 2026-09-08. The 2026-09-19 Turnstile audit found five pins at the top of their ranges, against this file's own lower-bound rule (Blue Beetle, Shazam! Fury of the Gods, Joker: Folie à Deux, Venom: The Last Dance, and First Steps' gross rather than its net); corrected. filed_net lists the six films whose figure comes from a studio filing: most of their peers carry BOM or press figures, and the page flags these six wherever it compares them.
